te: Mary Wollstonecraft Shelley (anonymously) publishes the pioneering work of science fiction, Frankenstein; or, The Moder…
dz: 玛丽·沃尔斯通克拉夫克·雪莱(英语:Mary Wollstonecraft Shelley (unnymoy))出版科幻小说"弗兰肯斯坦"(Frankenstein;或作"现代普罗米修斯")的开创性作品,在伦敦.
de: Mary Wollstonecraft Shelley (anonymously) publishes the pioneering work of science fiction, Frankenstein; or, The Modern Prometheus, in London.

te: The British Institution of Civil Engineers is founded by a group of six engineers; Thomas Telford would later become it…
dz: 英国土木工程师学会由六位工程师创立；托马斯·特尔福德后来成为其第一任主席。
de: The British Institution of Civil Engineers is founded by a group of six engineers; Thomas Telford would later become its first president.

t: 大卫·布鲁斯特的一篇论文 被读到皇家学会, 迟到地宣布他发现了 我们称之为双轴重力晶体的双轴级…
te: A paper by David Brewster is read to the Royal Society, belatedly announcing his discovery of what we now call the biax…
dz: 大卫·布鲁斯特的一篇论文 被读到皇家学会, 迟到地宣布他发现了 我们称之为双轴重力晶体的双轴级。 同日,奥古斯丁-让·弗雷斯内尔(Augustin-Jean Fresnel)就两极分光的反射问题签下"补充"(四天后提交).
de: A paper by David Brewster is read to the Royal Society, belatedly announcing his discovery of what we now call the biaxial class of doubly-refracting crystals. On the same day, Augustin-Jean Fresnel signs a "supplement" (submitted four days later) on reflection of polarized light.

t: 让-巴蒂斯特·贝尔纳多特登上瑞典和挪威的王位.
te: Jean-Baptiste Bernadotte ascends to the thrones of Sweden and Norway.
dz: 让-巴蒂斯特·贝尔纳多特登上瑞典和挪威的王位.
de: Jean-Baptiste Bernadotte ascends to the thrones of Sweden and Norway.

t: Bernardo O'Higgins 在智利康塞普西翁附近正式批准《智利独立宣言》。
te: Bernardo O'Higgins formally approves the Chilean Declaration of Independence near Concepción, Chile.
dz: Bernardo O'Higgins 在智利康塞普西翁附近正式批准《智利独立宣言》。
de: Bernardo O'Higgins formally approves the Chilean Declaration of Independence near Concepción, Chile.

t: 物理学家奥古斯丁·弗雷斯内尔(Augustin Fresnel)向法兰西科学院宣读了关于光学旋…
te: Physicist Augustin Fresnel reads a memoir on optical rotation to the French Academy of Sciences, reporting that when po…
dz: 物理学家奥古斯丁·弗雷斯内尔(Augustin Fresnel)向法兰西科学院宣读了关于光学旋转的回忆录,报告称,当极化光被一个弗雷斯内尔rhomb"去极化"时,其特性通过光学旋转晶体或液体在以后的任何一段中保存.
de: Physicist Augustin Fresnel reads a memoir on optical rotation to the French Academy of Sciences, reporting that when polarized light is "depolarized" by a Fresnel rhomb, its properties are preserved in any subsequent passage through an optically-rotating crystal or liquid.

t: 美国国会肯定了第二届大陆大会,通过美国国旗,每个州有13个红白条纹和一星(当时为20个).
te: The United States Congress, affirming the Second Continental Congress, adopts the flag of the United States with 13 red…
dz: 美国国会肯定了第二届大陆大会,通过美国国旗,每个州有13个红白条纹和一星(当时为20个).
de: The United States Congress, affirming the Second Continental Congress, adopts the flag of the United States with 13 red and white stripes and one star for each state (20 at that time).

t: 在梅普之战中,由贝尔纳多·奥希金斯和何塞·德·圣马丁所领导的智利独立运动取得了对西班牙的决定性…
te: In the Battle of Maipú, Chile's independence movement, led by Bernardo O'Higgins and José de San Martín, win a decisive…
dz: 在梅普之战中,由贝尔纳多·奥希金斯和何塞·德·圣马丁所领导的智利独立运动取得了对西班牙的决定性胜利,使2000名西班牙人和1000名智利爱国者丧生.
de: In the Battle of Maipú, Chile's independence movement, led by Bernardo O'Higgins and José de San Martín, win a decisive victory over Spain, leaving 2,000 Spaniards and 1,000 Chilean patriots dead.

t: 美国参议院批准了"拉什-巴哥特条约",限制大湖和香普兰湖的海军军备.
te: The United States Senate ratifies the Rush–Bagot Treaty, limiting naval armaments on the Great Lakes and Lake Champlain.
dz: 美国参议院批准了"拉什-巴哥特条约",限制大湖和香普兰湖的海军军备.
de: The United States Senate ratifies the Rush–Bagot Treaty, limiting naval armaments on the Great Lakes and Lake Champlain.

t: 法国物理学家奥古斯丁·弗雷斯内尔(英语:Augustin Fresnel)在他的初步作词"Di…
te: French physicist Augustin Fresnel signs his preliminary "Note on the Theory of Diffraction" (deposited on the following…
dz: 法国物理学家奥古斯丁·弗雷斯内尔(英语:Augustin Fresnel)在他的初步作词"Diffraction理论上的说明"(于次日放出). 该文件以我们现在所称的弗雷斯内尔组成部分为结尾.
de: French physicist Augustin Fresnel signs his preliminary "Note on the Theory of Diffraction" (deposited on the following day). The document ends with what we now call the Fresnel integrals.

t: 1818年的"美国国旗法"生效,为每个州创造了一面有恒星的13分旗. 每个新州入盟后的7月4日…
te: U.S. Flag Act of 1818 goes into effect creating a 13-stripe flag with a star for each state. New stars are to be added …
dz: 1818年的"美国国旗法"生效,为每个州创造了一面有恒星的13分旗. 每个新州入盟后的7月4日将增加新星.
de: U.S. Flag Act of 1818 goes into effect creating a 13-stripe flag with a star for each state. New stars are to be added on the July 4 following the admission of each new state to the Union.

t: 法国物理学家奥古斯丁·弗雷斯内尔(Augustin Fresnel)提交了他获奖的"关于光的分…
te: French physicist Augustin Fresnel submits his prizewinning "Memoir on the Diffraction of Light", precisely accounting f…
dz: 法国物理学家奥古斯丁·弗雷斯内尔(Augustin Fresnel)提交了他获奖的"关于光的分光作用的Memoir",准确说明了光向阴影扩散的有限程度,从而摧毁了最古老的对光波理论的反对.
de: French physicist Augustin Fresnel submits his prizewinning "Memoir on the Diffraction of Light", precisely accounting for the limited extent to which light spreads into shadows, and thereby demolishing the oldest objection to the wave theory of light.

t: 瑞典卡尔三世-挪威被加冕为挪威国王,位于特隆赫姆.
te: Carl III of Sweden–Norway is crowned king of Norway, in Trondheim.
dz: 瑞典卡尔三世-挪威被加冕为挪威国王,位于特隆赫姆.
de: Carl III of Sweden–Norway is crowned king of Norway, in Trondheim.

t: 美国和英国签署了《1818 年公约》，该公约将加拿大与美国的边界大部分长度定在北纬 49 度线。
te: The Convention of 1818 is signed between the United States and the United Kingdom, which settles the Canada–United Stat…
dz: 美国和英国签署了《1818 年公约》，该公约将加拿大与美国的边界大部分长度定在北纬 49 度线。
de: The Convention of 1818 is signed between the United States and the United Kingdom, which settles the Canada–United States border on the 49th parallel for most of its length.

t: 伊利诺伊州成为美国第21个州.
dz: 伊利诺伊州成为美国第21个州.

te: Cyril VI of Constantinople resigns from his position as Ecumenical Patriarch under pressure from the Ottoman Empire.
dz: 君士坦丁堡的西里尔六世在奥斯曼帝国的压力下辞去普世牧首的职务.
de: Cyril VI of Constantinople resigns from his position as Ecumenical Patriarch under pressure from the Ottoman Empire.

te: The first performance of "Silent Night" takes place in the Nikolauskirche in Oberndorf, Austria.
dz: "寂静之夜"的首场演出在奥地利奥伯恩多夫的尼古拉斯克奇.
de: The first performance of "Silent Night" takes place in the Nikolauskirche in Oberndorf, Austria.
